basic_details.job_title: PBTI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Project Assistant, Project Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Biotechnology Incubator (PBTI), under the Department of Science, Technology & Environment, Government of Punjab, has invited applications for eight project positions under Advt. No. PBTI/01/PRO/2026-27. The posts are purely contractual, for one year or the project duration, with fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 49,000. A hard copy of the application must be received at PBTI, Mohali, by 4 December 2026, and Proforma-II must also be e-mailed to [email protected] on or before the due date.

content_sections.heading: About PBTI
content_sections.text: Punjab Biotechnology Incubator is part of the Department of Science, Technology & Environment, Government of Punjab. Its address in the notice is Knowledge City, Sector - 81, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab - 140306. The notice also prints its website, pbtilabs.punjab.gov.in, and the e-mail [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists eight positions across three projects, one vacancy for each. Eight vacancies are open in total, and the category column shows UR (Unreserved) or SCW (Scheduled Caste Woman). The notice says the number of posts may be increased or decreased as per the decision of PBTI.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification, experience and age differ by post. Each post is described below in the notice's order. Essential qualification: Master's Degree in Basic/Life Sciences subjects/Environmental Sciences/Food sciences OR B.Tech or equivalent in Biotechnology/Food Technology/Dairy Technology OR B.Pharma from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks. Experience: five (05) years experience in scientific activities or services in Industry or Academia or Research Organizations or any other Scientific body. Also essential: sound knowledge of all MS-Office tools; excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Desirable: experience of designing and executing Human Resource Development programmes/Skilling/training programs/Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) related activities; Degree/diploma in Business Administration. Age: 37 years or below. Essential qualification: the same as for Principal Project Associate (Master's Degree in Basic/Life Sciences subjects/Environmental Sciences/Food sciences OR B.Tech or equivalent in Biotechnology/Food Technology/Dairy Technology OR B.Pharma, minimum 60% aggregate marks). Experience: two (02) years experience in scientific activities or services in Industry or Academia or Research Organizations or any other Scientific body. Also essential: sound knowledge of all MS-Office tools; excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Desirable: the same as for Principal Project Associate. Age: 35 years or below. Essential qualification: Graduation in Science with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. Desirable: experience of coordinating/executing Human Resource Development programmes/Skilling/training programs/Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) related activities; computer course (min. 2 months) of MS Office with knowledge of creative online tools like Canva. Age: 28 years or below. Essential qualification, any one of: (i) Ph.D. with research in relevant area; OR (ii) 1st class M.Tech or equivalent in Biotechnology/Food Technology/Dairy Technology OR 1st Class M.Pharma from a recognized University/Institute, with at least 02 years analytical experience in the relevant field after essential qualification; OR (iii) 1st class Master Degree in Basic/Chemical/Life/Environmental Sciences/Food Sciences from a recognized University/Institute, with at least 03 years analytical experience in the relevant field after essential qualification. Desirable: experience of working with national/international testing and certification laboratories/organizations; knowledge of national/international Laboratory Quality Management Systems and standards for quality testing. Age: below 37 years. Essential qualification, either (i) 1st class M.Tech or equivalent in Biotechnology/Food Technology/Dairy Technology OR 1st Class M.Pharma from a recognized University/Institute, with at least 01 year analytical experience in the relevant field after essential qualification; OR (ii) 1st class Master Degree

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice states the pay as fixed monthly emoluments, shown per post in the vacancy table: Rs. 49,000 (Principal Project Associate), Rs. 28,000 (Project Associate-II), Rs. 35,000 (Project Associate), Rs. 31,000 (Project Fellow) and Rs. 20,000 (Technical Assistant and Project Assistant). The positions are purely on contractual basis for one year, or project duration whichever is earlier, and co-terminus with the project. They are extendable as per requirement of the project.

Prepare training manuals and other resource material, scientific content writing etc. Any other task assigned from time to time. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies, one each in eight project positions across three projects, under Advt. No. PBTI/01/PRO/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PBTI project posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 04.12.2026. The hard copy must reach PBTI by then, and Proforma-II must be e-mailed on or before the due date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Technical Assistant at PBTI?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for Technical Assistant is Graduation in Science with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for PBTI posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post: Principal Project Associate 37 years or below, Project Associate-II 35 years or below, Technical Assistant 28 years or below. Project Associate, Project Fellow and Project Assistant: below 37 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PBTI project posts?
faq.answer: Fixed monthly emoluments are Rs. 49,000 for Principal Project Associate, Rs. 28,000 for Project Associate-II, Rs. 35,000 for Project Associate, Rs. 31,000 for Project Fellow and Rs. 20,000 for Technical Assistant and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 590 (non-refundable), paid by demand draft in favour of "Punjab Biotechnology Incubator" payable at Mohali or by NEFT. SC and ST candidates pay no fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill Proforma-I and Proforma-II from www.pbtilabs.punjab.gov.in, attach self-attested documents and the fee, and send the hard copy to PBTI, Sector-81, Knowledge City, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab-140306. E-mail Proforma-II to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process at PBTI?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit: qualifying degree marks 50%, additional relevant qualification/certification 10%, additional relevant experience up to 25%, and performance in interaction 15%.

faq.question: Q9. Are the PBTI posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual, for one year or project duration whichever is earlier, co-terminus with the project and extendable as per requirement of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post at PBTI?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply separately for each post. A single application for multiple positions will be summarily rejected.
